description.fun: A hairy crab that hangs upside down from cliffs, waiting to drop on its prey, though it can't stay that way for long before the blood rushes to its head. It sidesteps attacks and lunges for weak spots with its strong claws, and if it loses one, it grows it back. In Paldea, its claws and shell end up in dishes like Klawf al Ajillo.
description.guide: A Rock-type crab Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that ambushes prey from cliffs. A giant Klawf known as the Stony Cliff Titan lives in Paldea's South Province. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A cliff crab that gets dizzy hanging upside down
